gameLocalization.note: Names follow the paired Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones event records. The guide spelling 黒雲道 maps to 黒雲刀 / Kokuuntō, verified against passive 9101301 and its Slash Skill Final Power +1 effect. Lenticular Slash, Sharp Edge, Brutal Stab, Draw of the Sword, and Slay use the enemy records rather than same-named Identity skills. Normal story and dungeon variants, Shield amounts, Minus Coins, and temporary action-slot conditions are retained.

stageName.text: Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones: 5.5-23 and the Final Battle of the Sword Demon's Mind

lead.text: Lowering a Minus Coin enemy's SP can make it more dangerous. Use Slash and Pride damage to Stagger it, and arrange attacks to break the Shield before To Claim Their Bones.

statNote.text: Separately covers Normal 5.5-23 and the 5.5-24 dungeon final battle. The dungeon version appears first. Hard, BokGak, and Mirror Dungeon HP values and extra buffs are excluded.

skillNote.text: Attacks, Evade, and Counters all use Minus Coins. Displayed Power ranges reflect Coins alone; see effects for To Claim Their Bones' Shield-dependent Clash Power buffs. Its area version and single-target version at 20% HP or lower are distinct skills.

priorities.0.text: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher, prioritizing Slash and Pride. Sinking-focused teams can strengthen the enemy's Minus Coin skills.

priorities.1.text: Offset Evade and attack before To Claim Their Bones to break its Shield: 50 in 5.5-23, 200 in the final battle.

priorities.2.text: Prepare to finish the final battle from around 20% HP. Concentrate strong skills and E.G.O during Stagger and the closing phase.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Lowering the enemy's SP made it stronger

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Minus Coins are stronger on Tails. The enemy also has unusual SP rules: winning clashes lowers his SP. Recover by removing Sinking, choosing winning clashes for your team, or Staggering him before he acts.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: To Claim Their Bones is too powerful to beat

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Power rises if the Combat Start Shield remains until use. Break it with earlier attacks, then clash against the base maximum of 25 in 5.5-23 or 28 in the final battle.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: The attacks meant to break the Shield were Evaded

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Offset the enemy's Evade with a defense skill. Preparing only a Stagger handler and a finisher clash handler is insufficient if the earlier attacks are Evaded.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: The enemy healed just before defeat

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: At 20% HP or lower in the final battle, patterns change to include an unredirectable To Claim Their Bones and a Counter. Assemble strong skills before 20% and finish him during Stagger.

units.0.notes.0.text: The Normal dungeon final battle, distinct from the Level 50, 2647-HP Hard version.

units.0.notes.1.text: Patterns change at 20% HP (about 309) or lower. To Claim Their Bones has a 6-Attack-Weight area version and an unredirectable single-target version.

units.0.notes.2.text: Build SP and E.G.O resources in the dungeon before entering. Check actual skills as well as the Stagger cycle.

units.1.notes.0.text: The regular stage before the dungeon. SP and resources must be built during the encounter.

units.1.notes.1.text: Uses 5 attacks each turn plus Evade or Counter. To Claim Their Bones has 50 Shield here; do not confuse it with the final battle's 200.

phases.0.title.text: Enable your main Slash/Pride damage dealers

phases.0.steps.0.text: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher. Both encounters resist Blunt, Lust, and Gloom; prioritize leveled Slash/Pride attackers.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Deploying 5 Sinners under the limit of 6 can give extra slots to the first deployed damage dealer. If reducing the team size, check that enough actions remain to Offset Evade and handle dangerous clashes.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Prepare both an early Shield breaker and a later clash handler for To Claim Their Bones. Check actual attack order rather than only choosing fast Sinners.

phases.1.title.text: Build SP through Clashes you can win

phases.1.steps.0.text: Assign winning clashes such as Draw of the Sword to main attackers. Each clash your team loses lowers enemy SP and strengthens Minus Coins; avoid multiple clashes with little chance of winning.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Use defense or resistance against powerful attacks, Offset Evade, and damage the boss. Once the main team's SP rises, focus damage toward Stagger.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Check Slash resistance and remaining HP on the first Sinner to trigger Yield My Flesh. Avoid having the initiating attack leave your main attacker Staggered by the Counter.

phases.2.steps.0.text: To Claim Their Bones gains 50 Shield at Combat Start. If any remains on use, Clash Power +5; break it with clashes or one-sided attacks that resolve before the skill.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Offset Evade so it does not stop earlier attacks. Prepare E.G.O or another skill that can beat the maximum of 25 after the Shield breaks.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Staggering him before To Claim Their Bones acts is another option. Concentrate damage during Stagger, defeat him, and enter the dungeon.

phases.3.title.text: Carry resources in and prepare for 200 Shield

phases.3.steps.0.text: Prepare HP, SP, and E.G.O resources before the final battle. Recheck resistance and To Claim Their Bones rather than treating it as the same enemy from the previous stage.

phases.3.steps.1.text: The area To Claim Their Bones has 6 Attack Weight and 200 Shield; remaining Shield gives +10 Clash Power for a maximum of 38. Resolve several Shield-breaking attacks first, then stop it with the later clash.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Exploit the ×2 Pride multiplier and Slash weakness to reach the 60% HP Stagger. Do not exhaust every finisher against weak attacks; save damage for Stagger too.

phases.4.title.text: Finish before the dangerous single-target version

phases.4.steps.0.text: At 20% HP or lower, Growing Resentment increases every turn and no longer expires at Turn End. The single-target To Claim Their Bones prioritizes low-HP Sinners and cannot be redirected.

phases.4.steps.1.text: Finish from around 20% during Stagger or a turn with strong skills available. If follow-up damage is insufficient, also prepare healing for low-HP Sinners and Counter protection.

phases.4.steps.2.text: Allowing a kill doubles Growing Resentment and enables healing. Do not take dangerous clashes with weak attacks even when little enemy HP remains.

skills.0.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3.

skills.0.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3.

skills.0.response.text: 2 Minus Coins with Base Power 8. Easier to beat than other opening attacks; use it to raise your main attackers' SP. Its on-use Poise is gained even if you win.

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3.

skills.1.effects.2.text: [On Hit] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn

skills.1.response.text: A 3-Coin attack stacking Bleed and next-turn Paralyze. If your team loses, enemy SP falls and the enemy strengthens further; consider defense or Staggering him first when unable to win.

skills.2.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise and 1 Poise Count

skills.2.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Slash Damage Up next turn

skills.2.effects.4.text: [On Hit] Inflict 2 Slash Resist Down next turn

skills.2.response.text: Hits weaken Slash resistance, making later attacks more dangerous. Choose the handler from predictions including enemy Poise and buffs.

skills.3.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 3 Poise and 1 Poise Count

skills.3.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 2 Slash Damage Up next turn

skills.3.response.text: 3 Minus Coins with heavy Bleed and Paralyze. Low SP favors high rolls; do not assign weak attacks based only on the win prediction.

skills.4.effects.1.text: [On Use] If any Shield remains, Clash Power +5

skills.4.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Slash Resist Down

skills.4.effects.4.text: [On Hit] Inflict 10 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2

skills.4.effects.5.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] If any Shield remains, deal fixed damage to each target equal to Growing Resentment divided by Attack Weight

skills.4.response.text: The 5.5-23 area attack. With 50 Shield remaining, +5 Clash Power raises its maximum to 30. Resolve other clashes or one-sided attacks first to break the Shield, or stop it by Staggering him.

skills.5.response.text: Despite the displayed range of 4–12, this Minus Coin skill has Base Power 12. Offset it with a defense skill so Shield-breaking attacks are not Evaded.

skills.6.effects.0.text: Gain Growing Resentment equal to the damage taken from the skill that triggered this Counter

skills.6.response.text: An ordinary Counter that retaliates one-sidedly after being hit. Check Slash resistance and Stagger thresholds on the first attacker; do not lead with an ally near death.

skills.7.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3.

skills.7.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3.

skills.7.response.text: 2 Minus Coins with Base Power 8. Easier to beat than other opening attacks; use it to raise your main attackers' SP. Its on-use Poise is gained even if you win.

skills.8.effects.2.text: [On Hit] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn

skills.8.response.text: A 3-Coin attack stacking Bleed and next-turn Paralyze. If your team loses, enemy SP falls and the enemy strengthens further; consider defense or Staggering him first when unable to win.

skills.9.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise and 1 Poise Count

skills.9.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Slash Damage Up next turn

skills.9.effects.4.text: [On Hit] Inflict 2 Slash Resist Down next turn

skills.9.response.text: Hits weaken Slash resistance, making later attacks more dangerous. Choose the handler from predictions including enemy Poise and buffs.

skills.10.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 3 Poise and 1 Poise Count

skills.10.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 2 Slash Damage Up next turn

skills.10.response.text: 3 Minus Coins with heavy Bleed and Paralyze. Low SP favors high rolls; do not assign weak attacks based only on the win prediction.

skills.11.effects.2.text: [On Use] If any Shield remains, Clash Power +10

skills.11.effects.3.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Slash Resist Down

skills.11.effects.6.text: [On Hit] Inflict 10 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2

skills.11.effects.7.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] If any Shield remains, deal fixed damage to each target equal to Growing Resentment divided by Attack Weight

skills.11.response.text: The dungeon finale's area attack has 6 Attack Weight and reaches a maximum of 38 with its 200 Shield remaining. Break the Shield with earlier attacks, remove the bonus, then clash with a powerful skill.

skills.12.response.text: Despite the displayed range of 4–12, this Minus Coin skill has Base Power 12. Offset it with a defense skill so Shield-breaking attacks are not Evaded.

skills.13.effects.0.text: Gain Growing Resentment equal to the damage taken from the skill that triggered this Counter

skills.13.response.text: An ordinary Counter that retaliates one-sidedly after being hit. Check Slash resistance and Stagger thresholds on the first attacker; do not lead with an ally near death.

skills.14.effects.0.text: [On Kill] Gain 3 Offense Level Up and 3 Defense Level Up next turn

skills.14.response.text: A Counter used at 20% HP or lower. Killing an ally also raises the enemy's Offense/Defense Levels; concentrate damage on a turn when you can finish him.

skills.15.name.text: To Claim Their Bones (20% HP or lower)

skills.15.effects.1.text: Prioritize the target with the lowest current HP.

skills.15.effects.3.text: [On Kill] Heal HP equal to Growing Resentment

skills.15.effects.4.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Deal fixed damage equal to Growing Resentment

skills.15.response.text: An unredirectable single-target attack prioritizing low-HP Sinners. Fixed damage and on-kill healing can restore the fight in his favor; aim to Stagger and finish him from just above 20% HP.

passives.0.effect.text: At Turn Start, gain Growing Resentment if To Claim Their Bones is in an attack slot. Remove Growing Resentment at Turn End

passives.0.condition.text: Turns with To Claim Their Bones in an attack slot

passives.0.response.text: Damage taken builds Growing Resentment for To Claim Their Bones' fixed damage. Do not let the finisher hit with Shield remaining.

passives.1.effect.text: Effects that would change Panic Type do not change it. Instead, apply the effects intended for targets without SP.

passives.1.condition.text: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type

passives.1.response.text: Replacing Panic type is unavailable. Remember that lowering SP does not weaken this enemy in the usual way.

passives.2.effect.text: At Turn Start, gain Growing Resentment if To Claim Their Bones is in an attack slot. Remove Growing Resentment at Turn End

passives.2.condition.text: Turns with To Claim Their Bones in an attack slot

passives.2.response.text: Damage taken builds Growing Resentment for To Claim Their Bones' fixed damage. Do not let the finisher hit with Shield remaining.

passives.3.effect.text:
At 20% HP remaining, change patterns.
At 20% HP or lower, gain 20 Growing Resentment each turn starting next turn. Growing Resentment is no longer removed.

passives.3.response.text: Growing Resentment now increases every turn and no longer expires. Finish during Stagger or concentrate powerful attacks on the same turn.

passives.4.effect.text: When taking Sinking damage, gain 1 Defense Level Down next turn (5 times per turn)

passives.4.response.text: The Defense Level reduction comes with the downside of strengthening Minus Coin attacks through lower SP. Stacking Sinking alone does not make this encounter favorable.

passives.5.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic type, the Panic type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead

passives.5.condition.text: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type

passives.5.response.text: Replacing Panic type is unavailable. Remember that lowering SP does not weaken this enemy in the usual way.

mechanics.0.effect.text: While active, stores damage taken for To Claim Their Bones' fixed damage. Normally expires at Turn End; at 20% HP or lower in the finale, gains 20 every turn and stops expiring.

mechanics.0.response.text: Prevent the finisher from hitting with Shield remaining, then focus damage to avoid a prolonged closing phase.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Unusual SP rules: losing clashes raises the enemy's SP; winning clashes lowers it. Minus Coins tend to roll higher at lower SP.

mechanics.1.response.text: Avoid pushing the enemy to low SP through Sinking or clashes your team loses.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Gained at Combat Start; strengthens clashes if still present on use. First encounter: 50 / +5. Final battle's area version: 200 / +10.

mechanics.2.response.text: Arrange other attacks to remove it before the To Claim Their Bones clash begins.

warnings.0.text: A single Sinking user does not make the fight impossible, but an entire Sinking team amplifies the disadvantage against Minus Coins.

warnings.1.text: Evade also uses Minus Coins. Do not assume its low displayed minimum means it is easy to beat.

warnings.2.text: Making only the finisher clash handler too fast can start the clash before the Shield breaks. Always check attack order.

warnings.3.text: 5.5-23, the finale, Normal, Hard, and Mirror variants have different values. This page covers the Normal story encounters.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher with Slash/Pride damage dealers. If a Blunt-focused team lacks damage, review attack types too.

preparation.1.text: Prepare Shield-breaking damage, an Evade Offset, and powerful skills or E.G.O to clash against To Claim Their Bones.

preparation.2.text: Use dungeon resources and Gifts in the finale. No solo strategy or specific Gift is required; start with a team that can Stagger the boss using your available main attackers.

roles.0.reason.text: Damage the boss and Shield, then progress from Stagger to defeat. Adjust deployment order if using fewer Sinners.

roles.1.reason.text: Enable Shield-breaking attacks and preserve the intended attack order.

roles.2.reason.text: Stop To Claim Their Bones after breaking the Shield; also prepare for late Counters and unredirectable attacks.
